prompt:

Asset type: production website platform system artwork, standalone image with NO typography or interface.
Input image: approved visual reference for exact material, lighting, geometry, and composition. Extract and expand the SECOND SCENE showing three connected architectural levels into its own clean artwork. Remove all text, navigation, buttons, other sections and UI.
Canvas: 1600 x 1100 landscape.
Scene: seamless near-black #0a0b12 background. A wide three-level connected architectural structure made of highly detailed translucent smoke-gray glass and graphite. It is ONE continuous intricate installation, with three distinct but connected chambers on upper, middle and lower terraces; violet internal conduits branch through all three chambers. Match the reference second scene's delicate glass slabs, thin structural rails, cutaway walls, small internal machinery-like architectural details, dark nested partitions and connective tubes precisely. Physical, sophisticated dimensional installation, never a simple geometric approximation.
Composition: camera pulled back slightly from the reference hero, three-quarter view. Structure occupies mainly the RIGHT 75% with generous empty dark space in the LEFT 28% above the incoming signal. Keep all three chambers legibly separated by their levels, upper chamber around 27% canvas height, middle chamber around 53%, lower chamber around 78%. A violet line enters horizontally from far left near 70% canvas height, joins a central vertical trunk, and branches via architectural turns into all three chambers. The installation spreads laterally into terraces, all connected by the same delicate scaffold. Entire structure fits the image, with dark edge margins. Dark architecture with restrained pale violet internal light and sharp tiny detailing. Preserve visual complexity, smoky transparency, spatial depth and coherent connection.
Palette: near black #0a0b12, smoke graphite glass, desaturated violet #a781ff signal and restrained lilac glow. Clean low-key studio lighting and restrained bloom.
Constraints: NO text, letters, logos, labels, numbers, controls, buttons, UI, border, watermark, people, icon. Do not create the webpage. Only the standalone second-scene artwork. No isolated floating cubes, no flat vector schematic, no simple isometric block illustration. No bright background gradient in the left negative space.
